# TiDB reject-fuzz known over-acceptances (baseline). family<TAB>sql.
# Each is a real omni-accept/TiDB-reject; to be minimised into
# compat.tsv and fixed across the forks (PR e), then dropped here.
#
# The space-before-paren over-acceptances (`select count ( * )` and the
# spaced aggregate/scalar forms it shared a cause with) are fixed in
# checkSpacedFuncWord (tidb/parser/temporal.go), held by TestTiDBSpacedFuncWords.
#
# `*` as an operand (`select * = t`), found 2026-11-12 when compat.tsv's generated
# rows, the sweep's seeds, changed, is fixed in parseSelectWildcard
# (tidb/parser/select.go), held by TestWildcardFieldForms. A third `@` on a system
# variable (`select @@@a`), found the same day when that fix's rows changed the
# seeds again, is fixed in parseSysVarName (tidb/parser/name.go), held by
# TestSystemVariableAtForms. compat.tsv's suite:reject-fuzz rows hold both.
